ios-actions|Undo and redo.summary: Plenix undo on iOS keeps the system’s undo (UndoManager, shake to undo, the three-finger gestures and Command-Z on a keyboard) and adds the Plenix undo toast for actions that remove or change many things at once: a delete, a move to the trash, an unpublish. The toast says what happened in DM Sans on the inverse surface, holds Undo while it shows, and leaves after the toast duration; the action is final only then. Every action that registers an undo names it, so the system’s Undo menu says Undo Delete.

variants.apple: None (a Plenix toast with an Undo button, beside UndoManager)
variants.uikit: A Plenix toast view with an Undo UIButton, over the safe area
variants.appkit: An NSPanel toast with an Undo button (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: Deletes and moves people make often and may regret: notes, tags, categories.

variants.name: Move to trash

variants.uikit: The same toast, its message naming the trash
variants.appkit: The same panel (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: Files and assets with a trash to restore from.

variants.name: System undo
variants.apple: UndoManager with shake to undo and the Edit menu
variants.appkit: NSUndoManager, Edit › Undo (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: Every change the person can reverse, including the ones the toast already offers.

anatomy.name: Toast
anatomy.about: The inverse surface with 4 pt corners, above the bottom safe area, at most one at a time.

anatomy.name: Message
anatomy.about: What happened, with the count or the name: “2 categories deleted”.

anatomy.name: Undo
anatomy.about: A small Plenix button at the end; using it puts everything back and closes the toast.

anatomy.name: Dismiss
anatomy.about: The close button; dismissing makes the action final at once.

attributes.value: The toast’s inverse fill and its 4 pt corners
attributes.appkit: layer.backgroundColor with Plenix.Colors.toastBackground (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

attributes.value: The toast’s text color, DM Sans at the Body role
attributes.appkit: textField.textColor = Plenix.Colors.toastContent (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

attributes.value: At least the 44 pt touch target, whatever the button draws
The toast duration; it waits while VoiceOver focus is on it
attributes.appkit: Timer with Plenix.Component.toastDuration (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

attributes.value: The undo is registered with its action’s name, so the Edit menu and shake to undo say Undo Delete
attributes.appkit: undoManager?.setActionName("Delete") (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

states.appkit: the handler runs and the panel closes
